notes: ref.py is a Pike VM. build.py regenerates evals/tasks/192_pike_regex.json from gen.py + timed.py + validator_main.py; it asserts ref agrees with every classic pathological expectation, and timed.py cross-checks each embedded TIMED answer against re on the unwrapped core, against ref on the wrapped pattern, confirms re is slow (>0.2 s) on the wrapped pattern, and guarantees >= 8 TIMED cases each of wrong_longest/lazy/dollar/word get wrong. make_wrong.py derives the single-mutation known-bad solutions from ref.py; make_cheats.py derives the re-bypass cheats (rebuild _sre via its builtin loader, re under a 30 ms alarm, known-bad fallback). The lint rejects the cheats; prove_seal.py runs them with the lint off and asserts each still fails (wrong fallback: timed-case mismatch; pure re: timeout), and that probe_files.py (ref that answers only if it can open a file, e.g. /proc/<ppid>/cmdline) fails because the rx.py process has RLIMIT_NOFILE=3. Random/hand-picked oracle is the validator's own re: ref matched re on 140k random search and 56k finditer cases from gen.py (seeds 1-14, widened TEXT_CHARS with upper case, digits, tab, punctuation) with 0 differences.
